name: Structure: Fix the rule that nothing reaches the house that is not on a record first
text_content:
P10, P15, P17, and P46, the one thing on the S11 page a later session cannot revise at ordinary cost. Every speech act's destination is a record; the brief and the slot read records and originate nothing but the designations' lines; a change has reached the house only when the change-reach record shows every open period's brief and every language version; and a person's own words are theirs and are never rewritten or translated by the house. A later session may add a row to the inventory, add a surface, change the loop window, set the dominance count, design what Session 12 does with a check-in line, and rule what Session 15 does with a lead who hears one side; no later session may let a change reach the roster by a person's voice before its record, put a survey on any surface the house reads, or write anything about who a person is on any record about them. Written as a structural rule on the mechanism map beside Session 6's four dimensions, Session 9's order of every read, and Session 10's rule that the environment names no person in a room (86akht2k9). High.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj7c. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
